en.heroIntro: I am Yingying (Yaney) Li, a psychological counselor and independent researcher based in Leuven, Belgium. I hold an M.Sc. in Psychology from National Taiwan University and a B.A. in Anthropology from Sun Yat-sen University. My work connects counseling practice with research on brief, accessible psychological interventions for young people and caregivers. Current projects examine a digital single-session intervention for school refusal, self-concept development across childhood, and daily mood during emerging adulthood. I use longitudinal, person-centered, and mixed methods to investigate how, for whom, and in which contexts psychological support can help.
